urlText: L1 Fish Market lift out of service
content:
The lift at the Fish Market light rail stop on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line is temporarily out of service until further notice.
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use the opposite accessible entry/exit ramp via Bank Street.
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500
subtitle: L1 Fish Market lift out of service

properties.speechText:
